|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Red 5 (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “May add 1 astromech (once per game, may ▼ one here) and 1 pilot. While Luke piloting, immune to attrition < 6 and once per battle, may cancel game text (except related to capacity, identity and ability of permanent pilot) of a starfighter present for remainder of turn.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “May add Luke as pilot and [A New Hope] R2-D2 (may deploy here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle). During battle, may cancel a starfighter’s game text here (except related to capacity, ability, and identity of permanent pilot). Immune to attrition < 6.” '''What changed:''' “1 astromech (once per game, may ▼ one here)” → “Luke as pilot”; “1 pilot. While Luke piloting, immune to attrition < 6 and once per” → “[A New Hope] R2-D2 (may deploy here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle). During”; added “a starfighter’s”; added “here”; added “ability, and”; removed “and ability”; “pilot) of a starfighter present for remainder of turn.” → “pilot). Immune to attrition < 6.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 18. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Red 5]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Red 5 (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Red 5]]. Code OVS3 · GEMP id 1103_18.
